gold_assessment.reasoning: Generated cc-001 describes constant lower mid-abdominal pain, worsening, rated 8/10, which captures the chief complaint of abdominal pain (and even incorporates HPI pain severity).
Generated cc-001 and hpi-001 together describe constant lower mid-abdominal pain/continuous pain below the umbilicus that is worsening, matching periumbilical constant worsening pain.
Generated cc-001 explicitly states pain rated 8 out of 10, matching severity 8/10.
Generated hpi-002: light pink vaginal bleeding since menses ended 2 weeks ago captures light per vaginal bleeding, albeit with added timing detail.

Gold fact notes some difficulty passing urine with no dysuria/frequency. Generated facts only mention decreased urinary frequency (hpi-005), which is not the same as ‘difficulty passing urine’ and does not state that difficulty exists.

Gold notes BO daily, normal stool. Generated hpi-004 states constipation last week has resolved; this implies current bowel movements are back to normal, but daily and normal consistency are not explicitly stated. Because of the explicit resolution, this is reasonably considered covered.
Gold: constipation for a week last week. Generated hpi-004: constipation last week which has resolved. This matches and adds resolution detail.
Gold: LMP 2 weeks ago. Generated hpi-007: LMP approximately 2–3 weeks ago and normal; this contains the 2-week timeframe and adds approximation/normality.
Gold: last foreign travel 1 year ago. Generated sh-004: traveled abroad one year ago. Equivalent information.

Gold: denies dysuria or urinary frequency. Generated hpi-005 notes decreased urinary frequency, which is not a denial of urinary frequency; no generated statement explicitly denies dysuria/frequency as in ROS.
Gold: denies any additional per vaginal discharge. No generated fact comments on ‘no other PV discharge’.
Gold: eating and drinking are ok. No generated fact addresses eating or drinking status.

Gold: has not checked temp and does not feel feverish. Generated hpi-006 states patient denies fever, but does not mention not checking temperature or subjective feeling; partial but missing key elements, so considered omitted.
Gold: not feeling faint. Generated hpi-006: denies syncope; this reasonably aligns with not feeling faint.
Gold: denies shortness of breath or shoulder tip pain. Generated hpi-006: denies shortness of breath and shoulder pain; effectively the same ROS items.
Gold: patient reports nausea. Generated hpi-003 and asm-003 both state nausea without vomiting, which includes nausea.

Gold: denies vomiting or diarrhoea. Generated hpi-003: nausea (no V) captures denial of vomiting; diarrhoea is not addressed but vomiting is explicitly denied, so the main element is partially captured. Given nausea context with ‘no V’, we treat as covered for vomiting; diarrhoea detail is omitted but not contradicted.
Gold: PMH nil significant. Generated pmh-001 suggests a past medical history of allergy (‘ammo excellent’), which conflicts but does not capture the ‘nil significant’ statement.
Gold: patient takes no regular medications. Generated med-001 only states use of Implanon as a medication and does not state there are no other regular medications.
Gold: Implanon contraceptive implant inserted one year ago. Generated med-001: patient is using Implanon; while timing (1 year ago) is omitted, the medication/implant use is captured.
Gold: allergic to amoxicillin. Generated facts mention an allergy but not the specific agent ‘amoxicillin’.
Gold: works as a teacher. Generated sh-001: patient works as a teacher. Direct match.
Gold: has been able to work as usual. Generated social history contains occupation and living situation, but no comment on ability to work as usual.
Gold: lives with husband and his family. Generated sh-002: lives with husband and in-laws, which is equivalent.
Gold: does not smoke, drink alcohol, or use drugs. Generated sh-003 states no smoking/etOH/drugs. Direct match.
Gold: assessment abdominal pain ? cause. Generated asm-001: worsening lower abdominal pain, etiology to be determined. This captures the same uncertain cause of abdominal pain.
Gold: advised to perform a pregnancy test today. Generated plan-002: perform home urine pregnancy test today; this matches and adds 'home' and 'urine'.
Gold: contact clinic immediately if positive. Generated plan-002: if positive → immediate review. Equivalent.
Gold: urgent examination with doctor booked. Generated plan-001: arrange face-to-face clinic visit for abdo/pelvic exam via support line, consistent with an urgent examination booking.

Gold: get in touch earlier if pain worsens or new symptoms develop. Generated plan-003: return sooner if pain intensifies or unable to tolerate PO fluids. Pain worsening is captured; ‘unable to tolerate fluids’ is a specific concerning new symptom. Partially overlapping but key intent (seek earlier if worsening/new issue) is present.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold chief complaint only states abdominal pain. Generated cc-001 adds duration (few days), location as lower mid-abdomen, and severity 8/10 (which appears in HPI), making it an added-detail synthesis rather than strictly supported solely within the CC gold item.
Gold hpi-001: constant periumbilical pain. Generated describes continuous pain below the umbilicus; this is consistent with periumbilical pain.
Gold hpi-003: light PV bleeding, but no mention of pink color or that it has been present since menses ended 2 weeks ago. Timing and color are additional details.
Gold ros-007: nausea; ros-008: denies vomiting. Generated hpi-003: nausea without vomiting. This matches the combination.
Gold hpi-006: constipation for a week last week. Generated hpi-004: constipation last week which has resolved. Same history, with added resolution detail.

Gold ros-001: denies urinary frequency, implying normal frequency, and hpi-004: some difficulty passing urine. Generated hpi-005: decreased urinary frequency; this is not documented in gold and conflicts with ‘no frequency’ in ROS (which suggests not increased frequency, but does not state decreased). It introduces a different urinary symptom profile and is inconsistent with ‘no dysuria/frequency.’

Gold ROS denies SOB, shoulder tip pain, and faintness, and says no feverish feeling and temp not checked. Generated hpi-006 denies fever, SOB, shoulder pain, syncope, weight loss, blood in stool, and blood in urine. The denials of SOB and shoulder pain/syncope align partially, but explicit denial of measured fever, weight loss, hematochezia, and hematuria are not in gold, so overall this is an addition with partial overlap.
Gold hpi-007: LMP 2 weeks ago. Generated hpi-007: LMP approximately 2–3 weeks ago and normal. The approximate range and normality of the period are extra details not in gold.
Gold notes Implanon insertion 1 year ago but does not mention irregular cycles. Generated hpi-008 adds menstrual irregularity on Implanon, which is new information.
Gold facts do not mention sexual activity or timing of last intercourse. Generated hpi-009 is entirely new information.
Gold facts do not mention a prior urine pregnancy test or its result. Generated hpi-010 introduces a negative UPT one month ago.

Gold pmh-001: PMH nil significant. Gold allergy-001 separately documents allergy to amoxicillin, but PMH itself is recorded as nonsignificant. Generated pmh-001 claims PMH includes an allergy (‘ammo excellent’), so it conflicts with PMH: nil significant and also misrepresents the clearly documented amoxicillin allergy.
Gold has no statement about prior surgeries. Generated pmh-002 (no prior surgeries) is additional information.
Gold has no statement about prior pregnancies. Generated pmh-003 (no prior pregnancies) is new information.
Gold med-002: Implanon contraceptive implant inserted one year ago. Generated med-001: using Implanon as a medication; this is consistent with ongoing Implanon use.
Both gold and generated indicate the patient works as a teacher.
Gold sh-003: lives with husband and his family; generated sh-002: lives with husband and in-laws. Same content.
Gold sh-004: does not smoke, drink alcohol, or use recreational drugs. Generated sh-003 says no smoking/etOH/drugs; consistent.
Gold hpi-008: last foreign travel 1 yr ago. Generated sh-004: travel abroad 1 yr ago; same fact, categorized under social history.
Gold: abdominal pain, cause unclear. Generated asm-001: worsening lower abdominal pain, etiology to be determined; matches with added description of ‘worsening’ and ‘lower.’

Gold assessment only lists abdominal pain ? cause. Light PV bleeding is noted in HPI but not as a separate assessment item. Generated asm-002 elevates this to an explicit assessment diagnosis, which is additional structuring, not directly present in assessment section of gold.
Gold lists nausea in ROS, not in the assessment. Generated asm-003 treats ‘nausea without vomiting’ as part of the assessment, which is an added interpretive step.
Gold HPI notes constipation last week; assessment does not list resolved constipation as a separate problem. Generated asm-004 adds this as an assessment item.

Gold plan-003: urgent examination booked with Dr. Generated plan-001: arrange face-to-face clinic visit for abdo/pelvic exam via support line. Both describe arranging an in-person examination; generated adds modality details.
Gold plan-001/002: needs to check pregnancy test today and contact immediately if positive. Generated plan-002: perform home UPT today and immediate review if positive. Directly aligned.

Gold follow-up (fu-001) indicates contact earlier if pain worsens or new symptoms develop. Generated plan-003 adds a specific criterion of being unable to tolerate oral fluids, which is a more specific new symptom threshold not explicitly in gold.
